items.headline: Holders ~29% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.71: price is 29% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.477). Yet 56% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: -87% below trend AND fear at 29
items.detail: Deep in the Fire Sale band (-87% vs the power-law fair value $2.69) with Fear & Greed at 29. Valuation and sentiment bottoming together.
items.framing: Where value and fear overlap — historically the account's best-resonating zone.

items.headline: -85% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.71 = 2th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.71 sits at the 2th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 2th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: NUPL -0.4 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.4 (from MVRV 0.71) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: -87% below its long-run trend (Fire Sale band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.69; price sits -87% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 27,281 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,394 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-19.1% over 12w)
items.detail: The 9-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 5.65M SPX. 4w -1.3% · 12w -19.1% · 26w -24.4%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-19.1% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: -1.2σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1.2σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1.2σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: SOPR 1.275 — coins moving at a profit
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 1.275: coins that moved on-chain realised a gain on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — profit-taking (SOPR 1.275).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.
